summary.byArchetype: Western/outlaw 7 (gunslinger, bounty hunter, desperado, charlatan, bandit, preacher, cardsharp); Fantasy-knight/warrior 7 (plate tank, shieldmaiden, crusader, sellsword, fallen paladin, berserker, errant duelist); Sci-fi trooper 8 (powered-armor, hardlight op, drone-jockey, street-runner, void marine, infiltrator, heavy gunner, medic); Mage/caster 7 (sorcerer, hex-witch, seer, blood-mage, alchemist, rune-scribe, pyromancer); Samurai/wuxia 7 (ronin, monk, fox duelist, storm-fist, jade dancer, drunken master, oni enforcer, pilgrim healer); Ranger/hunter 7 (trapper, assassin, beast-tracker, swamp poacher, plague doctor, forest warden, crow rogue); Monster/non-human 7 (revenant, beast-kin, golem, elemental, eldritch cultist, plant-folk)

characters.name: Cordell "Coldsnap" Vane
characters.theme: Lone trail-worn gunfighter — the baseline outlaw silhouette
characters.palette: Dust-bowl neutrals: weathered tan duster, faded indigo shirt, gunmetal grey iron, oxblood-leather accents, pale alkali-bleached highlights
characters.artBrief: A lean upright humanoid in a long wind-tattered duster coat that flares behind in a hard angular silhouette, one clearly detached noticeably tall head floating slightly above the broad closed shoulders/body, the head wearing a wide-brim slouch hat tilted low over a deep full-height opaque shadowed head mass that extends substantially below the brim rather than reading as a hat with a thin shadow sliver, with no visible biological features, one detached hand hanging loose and curled beside a holstered revolver, the other resting flat. The head, body, two hands, and two feet are six disconnected floating pill-character parts with clear flat-green gaps; no neck, arms, legs, anatomical standing figure, or collage. Flat hand-painted CEL art, bold readable outline, side-profile facing right. Materials: cracked oxblood leather, sun-faded indigo cotton, dull gunmetal. Palette of dust-bowl tans, faded blue, and bleached alkali highlights.
characters.flavor: A quiet road-ghost who never draws first and never misses second.

characters.name: Magdalene "The Ledger" Crowe
characters.theme: Methodical manhunter who collects faces and folds them into her coat
characters.palette: Deep charcoal-black coat, bone-white wanted-poster paper, cold steel-blue, brass buckle gold, blood-rust red trim
characters.artBrief: A tall imposing humanoid in a heavy double-breasted charcoal coat bristling with rolled wanted-posters tucked into bandolier loops, a flat-crowned black hat, a tin star pinned crooked at the chest, one detached hand gripping a coiled rope-and-shackle, the other open and waiting. Flat hand-painted CEL art, bold blocky silhouette, side-profile facing right. Materials: oiled black wool, brass buckles, yellowed paper, cold blued steel. Palette of charcoal-black, bone-white, steel-blue, and rust-red accents.
characters.flavor: She does not want you dead — dead pays half — but she will settle.

characters.name: "Buzzard" Jeptha Hale
characters.theme: Brutish wanted man held together by scars, spite, and ammunition
characters.palette: Mud-brown rawhide, dried-blood maroon, tarnished brass cartridges, sweathered olive, dirty bone
characters.artBrief: A broad heavy-shouldered humanoid hunched forward in a sleeveless rawhide vest crossed by overstuffed cartridge bandoliers, a battered derby hat crammed low, a thick neck and barrel chest making a bulky aggressive silhouette, one detached hand a clenched scarred fist, the other dragging a sawed-off shotgun. Flat hand-painted CEL art, heavy menacing outline, side-profile facing right. Materials: greasy rawhide, tarnished brass, scarred bone. Palette of mud-brown, dried-blood maroon, brass, and dirty bone.
characters.flavor: Posters describe him as 'large, angry, and owed money.'

characters.name: Doctor Phineas Quill, Esq.
characters.theme: Silver-tongued huckster peddling miracle tonics from a coat full of bottles
characters.palette: Mustard-gold frock coat, bottle-green glass, copper labels, plum waistcoat, sickly chartreuse tonic glow
characters.artBrief: A spindly upright humanoid in a too-long mustard frock coat lined with rows of glowing bottle-green tonic vials, a tall battered top hat, a string tie and plum brocade waistcoat, posture leaning in mid-pitch with arms wide, one detached hand brandishing a luminous bottle aloft, the other tipping the hat. Flat hand-painted CEL art, slinky theatrical silhouette, side-profile facing right. Materials: worn velvet, clinking glass, tarnished copper, gilt buttons. Palette of mustard-gold, bottle-green, plum, copper, and a sickly chartreuse tonic glow.
characters.flavor: Two drops cures anything — three drops cures you of everything.

characters.name: The Bandida "La Sombra"
characters.theme: Veiled stagecoach robber who is a shape in the dust before she is a person
characters.palette: Dusk-violet serape, ash-grey kerchief, blackened iron, deep teal shadow, faded poncho-stripe accents
characters.artBrief: A lithe upright humanoid wrapped in a striped serape thrown over one shoulder, the lower face hidden by a tied bandana and the eyes shadowed under a low flat hat, a wide poncho hem making a triangular drifting silhouette, one detached hand thumbing back a blackened revolver hammer, the other holding the serape edge like a cape. Flat hand-painted CEL art, soft-edged mysterious outline, side-profile facing right. Materials: woven wool serape, dusty cotton kerchief, blackened iron. Palette of dusk-violet, ash-grey, blackened iron, and deep teal shadow.
characters.flavor: Witnesses agree only on the color of the smoke she left behind.

characters.name: Elias "Parson" Thorne
characters.theme: Hellfire revivalist who buries his sins under a Bible and two pistols
characters.palette: Funeral-black coat, ash-grey shirt, bone-white collar, weathered-silver cross, ember-orange page-edge glow
characters.artBrief: A gaunt severe humanoid in a buttoned funeral-black preacher's coat with a stiff bone-white collar, a flat parson's hat, a long silhouette broken by a thick clasped Bible hung on a chain and twin holsters beneath the coattails, posture rigidly upright, one detached hand pressing the Bible to his chest, the other hovering over a pistol grip. Flat hand-painted CEL art, austere vertical silhouette, side-profile facing right. Materials: dull black broadcloth, starched linen, tarnished silver, brittle gilt-edged paper. Palette of funeral-black, ash-grey, bone-white, weathered silver, and an ember-orange glow at the book's edge.
characters.flavor: He'll pray over your grave — he just wants to dig it himself.

characters.name: "Quickfinger" Odette Lacroix
characters.theme: Gambler-duelist who wins twice — once at the table, once at ten paces
characters.palette: Emerald-green satin, gold-leaf trim, ivory-and-black playing-card motif, garnet-red ribbon, brass derringer sheen
characters.artBrief: A statuesque upright humanoid in a fitted emerald riverboat-gambler's frock coat with gold-leaf brocade and a fanned bustle hem, a small tilted feathered hat, a sleek confident lean with the hip cocked, one detached hand fanning a spread of playing cards, the other concealing a tiny brass derringer at the cuff. Flat hand-painted CEL art, sleek hourglass silhouette, side-profile facing right. Materials: liquid emerald satin, gold thread, ivory card-faces, brass. Palette of emerald-green, gold-leaf, ivory-and-black, garnet-red, and warm brass.
characters.flavor: The house always wins — and tonight, she is the house.

characters.name: Sir Galloway the Unbending
characters.theme: Towering full-plate paragon — the immovable wall of the squad
characters.palette: Burnished steel-silver plate, deep royal-blue tabard, brass trim, warm white plume
characters.artBrief: Side-profile facing right, broad rectangular silhouette wider at the pauldrons than anywhere else; a hulking suit of full plate armor with a great barrel chest, a closed bucket-helm with a narrow vision slit and a single tall white plume, oversized rounded pauldrons and a kite shield slung on the back. Detached gauntleted fists and sabaton feet float in the Drifter rig. Flat cel-painted in burnished steel-silver with hammered highlights, a deep royal-blue tabard hanging to the knees, brass rivets and trim, hard rim-light on every plate edge.
characters.flavor: A knight so encased in steel he hasn't shown his face in twenty years and refuses to take a backward step.

characters.name: Greta Ironbraid
characters.theme: Fierce northern shield-line warrior — the anchor of the wall
characters.palette: Oiled tan leather and chainmail grey, ox-blood red trim, weathered round-shield wood, copper-blonde braid
characters.artBrief: Side-profile facing right, a strong compact silhouette broken by a huge round wooden shield gripped forward; a shieldmaiden in a riveted chainmail shirt over oiled tan leather, a winged or horn-accented helm with a long copper-blonde battle-braid spilling out the back, a short axe in the off-hand. Detached fists (one clutching the shield boss) and booted feet in the Drifter rig. Flat cel art, chainmail-grey rings, ox-blood red painted shield rim with a sun-burst boss, weathered timber and leather textures.
characters.flavor: Holds the line where braver souls broke and run, and dares the horde to test her wall.

characters.name: Brother Cassian, the Ashen Crusader
characters.theme: Holy warrior worn thin by a long campaign — faith hardened into fury
characters.palette: Sun-bleached bone-white tabard, dull grey mail, crimson cross, soot and dried-blood staining
characters.artBrief: Side-profile facing right, tall lean silhouette draped in a long flowing surcoat; a crusader in a hooded mail coif over grey chain, a bleached bone-white tabard bearing a bold crimson cross now smeared with soot and old blood, a longsword pointed earthward like a planted standard. Detached mailed fists and worn boots in the Drifter rig. Flat cel-painted, sun-bleached cloth with grime-shaded folds, dull desaturated grey mail, one searing crimson cross as the focal accent, a faint warm holy rim-glow.
characters.flavor: Marched a thousand miles for a cause he no longer remembers, and kills now out of habit and prayer.

characters.name: Dunkel the Coinblade
characters.theme: Mismatched freelance killer — loyal only to the next purse
characters.palette: Mismatched brown leathers, dull iron, a single looted gold pauldron, faded teal scarf
characters.artBrief: Side-profile facing right, a deliberately asymmetric, scrappy silhouette — one heavy looted pauldron, the other shoulder bare; a sellsword in patched brown leather and a half-buttoned gambeson, a battered open-faced kettle helm, a faded teal scarf knotted at the throat, a notched falchion slung lazily at the hip. Detached half-gloved fists and mismatched boots in the Drifter rig. Flat cel art, warm earthy leather tones, one gleaming looted gold pauldron breaking the palette, dull scratched iron, casual cocky posture.
characters.flavor: Fights for whoever pays best and grumbles about hazard rates the entire battle.

characters.name: Sir Mordrane, the Hollow Oath
characters.theme: Corrupted holy knight — once radiant armor now blackened and cursed
characters.palette: Blackened tarnished plate, sickly green-gold tarnish, dead-purple cloth, cold ember-cyan glow
characters.artBrief: Side-profile facing right, a once-noble plate silhouette now drooping and broken-edged, a tattered cape trailing low; a fallen paladin in blackened, corroded full plate streaked with sickly green-gold tarnish, a dented helm with a cracked face-plate leaking cold ember-cyan light from the eye-slit, a chipped greatsword wreathed in faint dark vapor. Detached gauntleted fists and sabatons in the Drifter rig. Flat cel-painted, near-black tarnished metal with toxic green-gold corrosion in the crevices, a dead-purple ragged cape, an eerie cyan inner glow as the only cold light.
characters.flavor: Kept his vow to never fall in battle — death simply chose to ignore it.

characters.name: Hrothgar Snowfang
characters.theme: Half-naked highland fury — raw muscle and frostbite over armor
characters.palette: Wind-burnt ruddy skin, grey wolf-pelt, weathered iron, woad-blue warpaint, frost-white fur
characters.artBrief: Side-profile facing right, a massive top-heavy silhouette of bare muscled torso, hunched and forward-leaning; a mountain berserker stripped to the waist with a shaggy grey wolf-pelt cloak and hood whose snout crowns his head, a thick braided beard, woad-blue warpaint streaks, and a huge two-handed iron axe hauled over one shoulder. Detached bare fists and fur-wrapped feet in the Drifter rig. Flat cel art, wind-burnt ruddy skin with warm shadow, frost-white and grey fur, weathered cold iron, bold woad-blue paint as the accent.
characters.flavor: Climbed down from the peaks for a fight and won't climb back until everything stops moving.

characters.name: Dame Veyra of the Thornwatch
characters.theme: Elegant lightly-armored swordswoman — speed and finesse over plate
characters.palette: Forest-green and silver, blackened fluted accents, rose-gold filigree, ivory plume
characters.artBrief: Side-profile facing right, a slim elegant silhouette with a poised forward lunge stance; an errant knight in fitted three-quarter armor — fluted breastplate and vambraces only, the rest supple forest-green cloth and tall riding boots — a feathered sallet helm with the visor raised and an ivory plume, a long slender rapier-like estoc extended ahead. Detached gauntleted fists (one fine-fingered on the hilt) and pointed boots in the Drifter rig. Flat cel art, polished silver and blackened fluting, deep forest-green cloth, delicate rose-gold filigree as the accent, clean confident lighting.
characters.flavor: Treats every brawl as a duel and every duel as a chance to be insufferably graceful about it.

characters.name: Bastion Vance
characters.theme: Heavy mil-spec exosuit juggernaut — the immovable frontline anchor
characters.palette: gunmetal #3A4049 body, steel #5A6472 plate, off-white #E8E4D8 trim, cyber-cyan #33E6FF visor slit
characters.artBrief: Side-profile facing right, same Drifter rig: a hulking blocky charcoal-gunmetal powered-armor torso with overlapping steel shoulder pauldrons and a thick segmented chest plate, topped by a heavy rounded combat helmet whose single narrow cyber-cyan visor slit glows as one flat bright shape; TWO huge detached rounded gauntlet hand-blobs and TWO broad detached armored boot-blobs planted wide, clear flat-green gaps around every part. Materials read as matte plated metal with one decisive shadow band; bold immovable wide-stance silhouette, flat cel, ~5 colours.
characters.flavor: A wall of plated steel who plants his boots and dares the swarm to move him.

characters.name: Halcyon-7
characters.theme: Sleek photon-construct duelist whose gear is half solid, half projected light
characters.palette: charcoal #22252B undersuit, steel #5A6472 frame, arc-violet #B14BFF hardlight panels, off-white #E8E4D8 seams
characters.artBrief: Side-profile facing right, Drifter proportions: a slim charcoal undersuit body wrapped in thin steel exo-strips, with a smooth visorless helm bearing one solid arc-violet eye-band; floating detached hand-blobs and feet-blobs are part matte steel, part flat arc-violet 'hardlight' panels read purely by colour contrast (no glow rays). Crisp angular plating with chamfered edges, one shadow band, clear gaps; poised forward-leaning duelist silhouette, flat cel, ~5 colours.
characters.flavor: Half operative, half projection — she only fully exists when she's mid-strike.

characters.name: Skitch Wren
characters.theme: Scrappy tinkerer rig festooned with a detached escort drone and antenna clutter
characters.palette: olive #6E7042 jumpsuit, gunmetal #3A4049 harness, tan #C49A5A straps, plasma-lime #9CFF3B drone eye
characters.artBrief: Side-profile facing right, same rig: a wiry olive-drab jumpsuit body under a cluttered gunmetal utility harness packed with canisters and a stubby antenna, headgear is a snug strapped flight-cap with a single round goggle lens over one bold eye; TWO detached glove hand-blobs (one raised as if commanding), TWO scuffed detached boot-blobs, and hovering just clear of the body a tiny separate disc-drone blob with one flat plasma-lime eye. Worn fabric and patched metal, one shadow band, clear gaps; busy-but-readable tinkerer silhouette, flat cel, ~6 colours.
characters.flavor: Never goes anywhere without his drone — and trusts it more than people.

characters.name: Neon Mirage
characters.theme: Fast acrobatic urban parkour courier built for speed and flash
characters.palette: charcoal #22252B bodysuit, gunmetal #3A4049 pads, hot-magenta #FF3BD4 accents, off-white #E8E4D8 wrap
characters.artBrief: Side-profile facing right, Drifter rig: a lean charcoal street-runner bodysuit with slim gunmetal knee-and-elbow pads and a streamlined low-profile aero-helm trailing a short wrapped scarf, one bold eye behind a thin hot-magenta visor strip (flat shape, no bloom); TWO sleek detached hand-blobs in fingerless grip-wraps and TWO light detached runner-shoe blobs caught mid-sprint, clear gaps. Taut fabric with magenta seam accents, one shadow band; dynamic forward-coiled sprinting silhouette, flat cel, ~5 colours.
characters.flavor: If the package has to be across the city in five minutes, you call her.

characters.name: Deepfall Korr
characters.theme: Hard-vacuum boarding marine in a sealed pressure suit built for the dark between worlds
characters.palette: steel #5A6472 hardsuit, charcoal #22252B joints, ember-orange #FF8A2B beacon, bone #CFC6AE markings
characters.artBrief: Side-profile facing right, same proportions: a bulky sealed steel pressure-hardsuit torso with ribbed accordion neck-and-joint seals and a small life-support backpack hump, a domed bowl helmet with one wide ember-orange beacon eye glowing as a flat solid shape; TWO thick detached gauntlet hand-blobs and TWO heavy mag-boot blobs, clear flat-green gaps. Scuffed bone-stencilled hull markings over matte steel, one decisive shadow band; grounded heavy-trudge silhouette, flat cel, ~6 colours.
characters.flavor: He breathes recycled air and fears nothing the vacuum can throw at him.

characters.name: Sable Cipher
characters.theme: Stealth netrunner-assassin all matte black with a fiber-optic data-trail aesthetic
characters.palette: charcoal #22252B stealthsuit, gunmetal #3A4049 panels, cyber-cyan #33E6FF circuit lines, steel #5A6472 buckles
characters.artBrief: Side-profile facing right, Drifter rig: a near-silhouette charcoal stealthsuit body with subtle gunmetal segmented panels, a sleek faceless infiltrator hood-mask broken only by thin flat cyber-cyan circuit lines and one cyan optic-eye; TWO slender detached hand-blobs in tight tactical gloves (one extended as if jacking in), TWO quiet detached soft-soled boot blobs, clear gaps. Matte dark fabric over hidden plating, single shadow band, sparse cyan line-accents read as 'lit' by contrast; low crouched predatory silhouette, flat cel, ~4 colours.
characters.flavor: You won't see her until your own systems are already hers.

characters.name: Grix Boltcaster
characters.theme: Squat ordnance specialist wearing an oversized stabilizer rig and energy-cell backpack
characters.palette: gunmetal #3A4049 rig, rust #A8482E plating, tan #C49A5A webbing, ember-orange #FF8A2B cell glow
characters.artBrief: Side-profile facing right, same rig: a short barrel-shaped gunmetal heavy-gunner body fronted by an oversized articulated stabilizer chest-brace and a blocky energy-cell backpack, headgear a riveted half-helm with a thick downturned brow and one squinting bold eye, a small ember-orange cell-port reading as a flat lit shape; TWO chunky detached recoil-gauntlet hand-blobs and TWO splayed detached stabilizer-foot blobs braced wide, clear gaps. Rust-streaked plate over gunmetal, one shadow band; squat heavy braced silhouette, flat cel, ~6 colours.
characters.flavor: Built low and wide so the recoil never knocks him off his feet.

characters.name: Vesper Lux
characters.theme: Field support operative with a backpack triage rig and a calmer, upright bearing
characters.palette: off-white #E8E4D8 suit, steel #5A6472 plate, dull-teal #3C6E6A cross panels, charcoal #22252B undersuit
characters.artBrief: Side-profile facing right, Drifter proportions: an upright off-white-and-steel support-trooper torso with clean segmented plating, a dull-teal flat cross panel on the chest, and a compact triage backpack with a folded support arm stowed at the shoulder; rounded smooth helm with a soft visor band over one calm bold eye, a small dull-teal indicator reading as a flat lit shape; TWO tidy detached glove hand-blobs and TWO steady detached boot-blobs, clear flat-green gaps. Matte bone-white panels with one shadow band; composed steady upright silhouette, flat cel, ~5 colours.
characters.flavor: The steady hand at your back who keeps the squad on its feet.

characters.name: Vellichor the Ash-Robed
characters.theme: Burnt-out arcane scholar who spends magic like a dying ember
characters.palette: Charcoal-grey robes, ember-orange trim, smoldering coal-red glow, bone-white accents
characters.artBrief: Tall narrow silhouette wrapped in heavy floor-length charcoal robes that taper to a frayed hem, a deep cowl swallowing the face into shadow with two ember-orange pinprick eyes; detached gloved hands cradle a single floating coal that bleeds smoke, robe edges trimmed in glowing ember-orange runework against bone-white piping. Flat CEL shading, side-profile facing right, bold readable Behemoth-x-Darkest-Dungeon silhouette.
characters.flavor: He rations his spells like a man counting his last breaths, certain each casting shortens his life.

characters.name: Mawkin Sourgrin the Hex-Witch
characters.theme: Swamp-crone who curses with grins, warts, and bottled spite
characters.palette: Sickly moss-green, bruise-purple, jaundiced yellow eyes, rusted iron buckles
characters.artBrief: Hunched-forward silhouette under a comically tall crook-tipped witch hat, a beaky warted profile with one jaundiced yellow eye and a wide stitched grin; layered ragged moss-green and bruise-purple shawls bristle with dangling charms and bottled hexes, detached hands stir a tiny floating cauldron while clawed feet hook talon-like. Flat hand-painted CEL art, bold spiky readable silhouette, side-profile facing right.
characters.flavor: She bottles grudges like preserves and uncorks them on whoever forgot to thank her.

characters.name: Iridia of the Nine Veils
characters.theme: Blindfolded prophet who walks star-charts instead of ground
characters.palette: Deep indigo and midnight-blue, starlight silver-white, cosmic teal glow, pale gold leaf
characters.artBrief: Serene flowing silhouette in trailing indigo veils that drift like nebulae, head crowned by a thin gold halo-ring and eyes bound in a star-flecked silver blindfold; detached hands hover open with a small orbiting constellation between the palms, robe scattered with pale gold star-leaf and a faint cosmic-teal aura at the hem. Flat CEL shading, elegant readable silhouette, side-profile facing right, Behemoth-x-Darkest-Dungeon look.
characters.flavor: She sees every future but the one she is standing in, which makes conversation difficult.

characters.name: Corvane the Crimson Draught
characters.theme: Aristocratic vein-tapper who pays for power in pints
characters.palette: Oxblood crimson, pale corpse-grey skin, black leather, glinting silver lancets
characters.artBrief: Lean upright silhouette in a high-collared oxblood coat slit to show pale corpse-grey skin laced with dark vein-lines, a sharp gaunt profile with a single hungry red eye; detached hands trail thin ribbons of floating blood drawn from rows of silver lancets strapped across the chest, black-leather wraps and a dripping crimson sash at the waist. Flat hand-painted CEL art, bold readable silhouette, side-profile facing right.
characters.flavor: Every spell costs him something, and he is generous with his own blood until he runs short, then yours.

characters.name: Tinker-Magnus Brasswick
characters.theme: Tinkering gear-mage who brews spells in pressurized glass
characters.palette: Antique brass, verdigris copper-green, amber potion-glow, soot-black rubber
characters.artBrief: Boxy gear-laden silhouette in a brass-buttoned soot-black coat, head encased in a riveted copper diving-helm with one round amber-lit goggle eye and a coiled exhaust pipe; a backpack of bubbling amber alembics vents steam, detached gauntleted hands grip a pressurized glass flask, verdigris-green plating and ticking gear-cogs studding the shoulders. Flat CEL shading, chunky readable silhouette, side-profile facing right, Behemoth-x-Darkest-Dungeon style.
characters.flavor: He insists magic is just chemistry no one has properly measured yet, and the explosions are data.

characters.name: Old Quill Grathmar the Rune-Scribe
characters.theme: Ink-stained loremaster who writes spells onto the air
characters.palette: Parchment-cream and ink-black, gold-leaf glyphs, deep teal mantle, oxidized bronze
characters.artBrief: Stooped scholarly silhouette draped in a parchment-cream robe printed edge-to-edge with ink-black glyphs and a heavy deep-teal mantle, an old bespectacled profile with one squinting eye; detached ink-stained hands write a glowing gold-leaf rune that hangs in the air, a floating bronze inkwell and a quill the size of a sword tucked behind the back. Flat hand-painted CEL art, bold readable silhouette, side-profile facing right.
characters.flavor: He believes the world is a manuscript and he is merely correcting its typos with lethal punctuation.

characters.name: Pyra Cinderhowl the Flame-Caster
characters.theme: Wild fire-witch who treats arson as honest expression
characters.palette: Scorched black and ash-grey, molten orange-red core, ember-gold sparks, smoke-purple haze
characters.artBrief: Wild jagged silhouette in scorched-black robes torn into flame-licked tatters that seem to flicker upward, a fierce upturned profile with molten orange-red cracks glowing through the skin and one blazing ember-gold eye; detached hands juggle a writhing fireball, wisps of smoke-purple haze trailing from singed hair and the hem dissolving into floating ember sparks. Flat hand-painted CEL art, bold spiky readable silhouette, side-profile facing right.
characters.flavor: She does not so much cast fire as let it out for a walk and apologize to no one.

characters.name: Sōjiro the Wayward Blade
characters.theme: Masterless swordsman of the rain-soaked roads
characters.palette: Storm-grey and faded indigo, with rust-red sash accents and weathered straw-tan
characters.artBrief: A lean upright humanoid in side-profile facing right, draped in a tattered storm-grey kimono and a wide conical straw kasa hat that breaks the silhouette with a low diagonal brim; one detached hand rests on a chipped katana at the hip while the other trails a frayed indigo sash. Flat hand-painted CEL art, bold readable outline, weathered straw-tan and rust-red accents over muted indigo, Behemoth-x-Darkest-Dungeon look.
characters.flavor: A masterless drifter who sells his blade only to those the world has already wronged.

characters.name: Brother Tendo of the Still Bell
characters.theme: Mountain ascetic who fights with prayer-beads and patience
characters.palette: Saffron and burnt ochre robes, charcoal undertones, with brass-gold beads and jade-green prayer cloth
characters.artBrief: A broad, grounded humanoid in side-profile facing right, swathed in heavy saffron-and-ochre monk robes that pool into a wide stable base, bald rounded head bowed forward; one detached hand grips a long brass-tipped staff, the other loops a string of oversized jade prayer-beads. Flat hand-painted CEL art, thick confident outline, warm saffron over charcoal shadow with brass-gold and jade highlights, Behemoth-x-Darkest-Dungeon look.
characters.flavor: Serene to the point of stillness, he answers violence with one perfectly timed strike.

characters.name: Yuki the Hollow Smile
characters.theme: Fox-masked killer who turns every fight into a dance
characters.palette: Bone-white and lacquer-black, with vermillion fox-mask markings and a single crimson cord
characters.artBrief: A slim, poised humanoid in side-profile facing right whose silhouette is crowned by a grinning white kitsune fox mask with sharp upturned ears and vermillion brushstrokes; a lacquer-black short-sleeved gi cinched by a crimson cord, detached hands held in a loose dueling guard with twin tantō. Flat hand-painted CEL art, crisp bold outline, bone-white and lacquer-black with vermillion mask accents, Behemoth-x-Darkest-Dungeon look.
characters.flavor: Behind the laughing fox is a duelist who has never once been seen to blink.

characters.name: Raijin Kō, the Storm Fist
characters.theme: Thunder-channeling brawler crackling with raw chi
characters.palette: Deep thundercloud blue-violet, electric cyan, and bronze, with white lightning-fork tattoos
characters.artBrief: A powerfully muscled humanoid in side-profile facing right, bare-chested under an open thundercloud-blue haori with the sleeves torn off, hair swept upward as if static-charged; detached fists wrapped in bronze knuckle-bindings that spit small cyan sparks, white lightning-fork tattoos crawling up the forearms. Flat hand-painted CEL art, heavy dynamic outline, blue-violet and electric cyan over bronze skin tones, Behemoth-x-Darkest-Dungeon look.
characters.flavor: Each of his punches lands a heartbeat before the thunder catches up.

characters.name: Mei-Ling of the Jade Ribbon
characters.theme: Whirling silk-and-fan combatant whose grace is a weapon
characters.palette: Jade-green and pale celadon silks, with gold-leaf trim and a sweep of lotus-pink
characters.artBrief: A graceful upright humanoid in side-profile facing right, mid-poised on the ball of one detached foot, wrapped in flowing jade-green and celadon silks that ribbon out behind her to widen the silhouette; one detached hand snaps open a gold-trimmed war-fan, the other lifts a trailing lotus-pink streamer. Flat hand-painted CEL art, elegant flowing outline, jade-green and celadon with gold-leaf and lotus-pink accents, Behemoth-x-Darkest-Dungeon look.
characters.flavor: Her dance is beautiful right up until the fan's hidden edge finds your throat.

characters.name: Old Gen, the Drunken Crane
characters.theme: Stumbling gourd-drinking elder hiding lethal precision
characters.palette: Earthy umber and moss-green rags, with a sun-bleached gourd and faded red waist-rope
characters.artBrief: A wiry, stoop-backed elder humanoid in side-profile facing right, leaning at a deceptive tipsy angle, long white wisp-beard trailing past a patched moss-green and umber robe; one detached hand dangles a sun-bleached drinking gourd on a cord, the other curls into a loose crane-beak fingertip pose. Flat hand-painted CEL art, loose characterful outline, earthy umber and moss-green with faded-red rope and bone-white beard, Behemoth-x-Darkest-Dungeon look.
characters.flavor: He sways like a drunk and strikes like a crane, and the wine is mostly an excuse.

characters.name: Kuro-Oni, the Demon Mask
characters.theme: Heavy-armored temple guardian wearing a wrathful demon mask
characters.palette: Blackened iron and deep oxblood lacquer, with brass studs and a horned crimson oni mask
characters.artBrief: A hulking, top-heavy humanoid in side-profile facing right, shoulders broadened by blackened iron lamellar plates and a horned crimson oni mask with bared brass fangs that dominates the silhouette; detached hands grip a long iron-banded tetsubō club resting against the shoulder. Flat hand-painted CEL art, massive bold outline, blackened iron and oxblood lacquer with brass studs and crimson mask, Behemoth-x-Darkest-Dungeon look.
characters.flavor: The temple's last wall against the dark, and he has never let it through.

characters.name: Asha the Ash-Walker
characters.theme: Barefoot wandering pilgrim trading blessings and bandages
characters.palette: Dusty cream and pale sage wraps, with a wide woven satchel of cinnabar-red and incense-smoke grey
characters.artBrief: A slender, calm humanoid in side-profile facing right, head wrapped in a soft cream travel-cloth, body bound in layered pale-sage pilgrim wraps with a wide woven cinnabar-red satchel slung across the chest; one detached hand carries a smoking brass incense-censer on a chain, the other holds a folded paper talisman, detached bare feet ashen from the road. Flat hand-painted CEL art, gentle clean outline, dusty cream and pale sage with cinnabar-red satchel and incense-smoke grey, Behemoth-x-Darkest-Dungeon look.
characters.flavor: She walks from shrine to shrine mending what the warriors leave broken behind them.

characters.name: Snarekeeper Vossel
characters.theme: A grizzled backwoods trapper draped in the spoils of his trade, festooned with hanging iron jaw-traps and coiled snare-wire, who reads the ground better than any map.
characters.palette: Tobacco-brown waxed leather, oxidized iron grey, frost-bitten bone white, dull moss green accents, with a single rust-orange lantern glow.
characters.artBrief: Side-profile facing right, full upright humanoid on the Drifter rig with detached hands and feet — a stooped, broad-shouldered trapper whose silhouette bristles with jagged iron jaw-traps and looping snare-wire dangling from a heavy fur-trimmed coat, a coil of wire gripped in one detached hand. Flat hand-painted CEL art: matte tobacco-brown waxed leather and worn pelts, oxidized iron-grey traps catching a thin cold rim-light, a battered tin lantern at the hip throwing one warm rust-orange spark; bold readable silhouette spiked by hanging metal teeth.
characters.flavor: He never chases — he just waits for the world to step where he told it to.

characters.name: The Hollow Mask
characters.theme: A faceless contract-killer wrapped in shadow-cloth, every line of the silhouette engineered for silence, identifiable only by the blank porcelain mask and twin curved daggers.
characters.palette: Ink-black and charcoal layered cloth, ash-grey wraps, bone-pale porcelain mask, a single bloodless crimson sash, cold steel highlights.
characters.artBrief: Side-profile facing right, Drifter rig with detached hands and feet — a lean, coiled assassin in tight wrapped shadow-cloth, hood drawn low over a smooth featureless porcelain mask that catches a sliver of moonlight, twin curved daggers held low and reversed in detached hands, a thin crimson sash trailing back. Flat hand-painted CEL art: deep ink-black and charcoal layered fabrics with crisp ash-grey edge highlights, the pale mask the single bright focal point, cold steel glints on the blades; a knife-sharp, narrow, predatory silhouette.
characters.flavor: You will not hear the question, only feel the answer.

characters.name: Bryda Houndcall
characters.theme: A wild-eyed beast-tracker bonded to her pack, antler-horned and pelt-cloaked, who hunts by scent and signal-horn across the deep wilds.
characters.palette: Earthy tan and umber hides, deep forest green wool, weathered antler ivory, leather-strap browns, with a flash of amber from a hunting horn.
characters.artBrief: Side-profile facing right, Drifter rig with detached hands and feet — a rangy beast-tracker in a layered hide cloak crowned with a salvaged antler headdress, a curved amber hunting-horn raised toward her lips in one detached hand and a coiled hound-leash in the other, quiver of bone-tipped darts at her back. Flat hand-painted CEL art: warm earthy tans, umber pelts and deep forest-green wool, weathered antler-ivory horns and a glowing amber horn as the warm focal accent; broad antlered silhouette reading instantly as a wilderness tracker.
characters.flavor: Her pack finds you long before she ever needs to look up.

characters.name: Mirelurk Caine
characters.theme: A muck-caked swamp poacher who melts into the bog, hung with eel-traps, fishing gigs and bottled lures, reeking of stagnant water and patience.
characters.palette: Sickly bog-green and silt-brown, waterlogged grey canvas, slime-glistening highlights, tarnished hook-iron, with a faint bioluminescent teal lure-glow.
characters.artBrief: Side-profile facing right, Drifter rig with detached hands and feet — a hunched, dripping swamp poacher in a tattered waterlogged canvas wrap and a wide drooping reed hat, a barbed three-pronged fishing gig in one detached hand and a netted catch of eel-traps slung over the shoulder, glass lure-vials at the belt. Flat hand-painted CEL art: sickly bog-green and silt-brown muck with slick wet highlights, tarnished hook-iron, and a faint bioluminescent teal glow leaking from a bottled lure; a low, lumpen, weed-draped silhouette that reads as part man, part swamp.
characters.flavor: The bog hides him, and he hides everything else.

characters.name: Doctor Quillane
characters.theme: A grim plague doctor who hunts the diseased and the cursed, beaked mask stuffed with bitter herbs, dispensing both cure and poison from the same satchel.
characters.palette: Tar-black waxed robe, brass-and-bone mask fittings, dried-blood maroon trim, bottle-glass green vials, with a sallow candle-yellow eye-glow.
characters.artBrief: Side-profile facing right, Drifter rig with detached hands and feet — a tall gaunt plague doctor in a floor-length tar-black waxed robe and wide flat-brimmed hat, a long curved brass-tipped bird-beak mask with glassy round eye-lenses, a fuming censer swinging from one detached hand and a leather vial-satchel of bottle-green tinctures at the hip. Flat hand-painted CEL art: matte tar-black robe with dried-blood maroon trim, brass and bone mask fittings catching cold light, bottle-glass green vials and a sallow candle-yellow glint behind the lenses; an imposing, narrow, beaked silhouette dripping menace.
characters.flavor: He cannot tell you which vial is the cure — that is rather the point.

characters.name: Warden Ashlock
characters.theme: A stoic forest warden sworn to the deep woods, armored in bark-lacquer and living moss, who answers trespass with a longbow drawn from generations of green silence.
characters.palette: Deep pine and olive greens, bark-brown lacquered plate, lichen sage-grey, weathered bronze, with golden dappled-leaf light accents.
characters.artBrief: Side-profile facing right, Drifter rig with detached hands and feet — a broad, grounded forest warden in bark-lacquered plate overgrown with creeping moss and lichen, a tall recurved longbow held upright in one detached hand and an arrow nocked in the other, a leaf-mantle cloak draped over the shoulders. Flat hand-painted CEL art: deep pine and olive greens over bark-brown lacquered armor, sage-grey lichen and weathered bronze fittings, with warm golden dappled-leaf light flecking the surface; a stout, rooted, sentinel silhouette crowned by the curve of the great bow.
characters.flavor: The trees told her you were coming, and the trees do not forgive.

characters.name: Crowmantle Sel
characters.theme: A feather-cloaked scavenger-rogue with a crow-beaked mask, light-fingered and quick-footed, who picks battlefields and pockets with equal ease.
characters.palette: Glossy blue-black feathers, bruised-purple cloth, tarnished silver trinkets, slate grey leather, with a sly glint of stolen gold.
characters.artBrief: Side-profile facing right, Drifter rig with detached hands and feet — a slight, perched-looking rogue draped in a glossy blue-black feather cloak with a sharp crow-beaked half-mask, fingers spread mid-pilfer in one detached hand while the other palms a tarnished silver trinket, pouches and dangling baubles jingling at the belt. Flat hand-painted CEL art: iridescent blue-black feathers over bruised-purple cloth and slate-grey leather, tarnished silver charms and a sly glint of stolen gold; a hunched, beaked, feather-fringed silhouette that reads as half-bird, half-thief.
characters.flavor: She didn't take it — it simply chose a better owner.

characters.name: Gravewake
characters.theme: A hanged outlaw who clawed back up the rope — a gallows-born revenant who fights with the calm of someone who has already died once.
characters.palette: Bone #CFC6AE body and off-white #E8E4D8 wraps over charcoal #22252B shadow, with a single dull-teal #3C6E6A grave-glow eye and frayed rust #A8482E noose.
characters.artBrief: Same Drifter rig and flat-cel look: a gaunt upright revenant on a bold readable side-profile facing right — a desiccated bone-and-off-white torso half-wrapped in grimy grave-shrouds, a frayed severed noose still cinched at the neck trailing a stub of rope, and a slack jaw under a single sunken dull-teal pinprick eye. EXACTLY two detached bean-shaped bone hands (no fingers) floating clear of each side and two detached bare bone feet below, each with a flat-green gap; charcoal spot-blacks in the eye-hollows and rib-shadows. Palette: bone #CFC6AE and off-white #E8E4D8 against charcoal #22252B, lone dull-teal #3C6E6A glow, rust #A8482E rope.
characters.flavor: Death already collected his debt, so he swings without a shred of fear left to lose.

characters.name: Snarlfang
characters.theme: A hulking wolf-kin scavenger raised by the pack — a feral, loping brawler who reads the hunt by scent and instinct.
characters.palette: Gunmetal #3A4049 pelt with steel #5A6472 highlights, tan #C49A5A muzzle and ear-tufts, muted-red #9E3B36 leather harness, plasma-lime #9CFF3B feral eye.
characters.artBrief: Same Drifter rig and flat-cel look: a broad-shouldered wolf-kin in bold side-profile facing right — a chunky gunmetal-grey furred torso with a jutting tan muzzle, pricked notched ears, a bristling shoulder-ruff, and one narrowed plasma-lime eye; a muted-red strap-harness with bone trophies crosses the chest. EXACTLY two detached rounded paw-mitt hands (no claws or fingers, just fur-tufted blobs) floating at each side and two detached hind-paw feet below, all with clear flat-green gaps; flat cel shadow bands in the pelt, charcoal spot-blacks under the ruff. Palette: gunmetal #3A4049 and steel #5A6472 fur, tan #C49A5A muzzle, muted-red #9E3B36 leather, plasma-lime #9CFF3B eye.
characters.flavor: Talks in growls, hunts by nose, and has never once lost a trail.

characters.name: Cogwarden
characters.theme: A salvaged automaton sentinel built from scrap-plate and a furnace heart — a tireless, slow-stomping iron guardian that simply does not stop.
characters.palette: Gunmetal #3A4049 plate over charcoal #22252B joints, steel #5A6472 rivets and bolts, rust #A8482E weathering, ember-orange #FF8A2B furnace-slit glow.
characters.artBrief: Same Drifter rig and flat-cel look: a blocky iron construct in bold side-profile facing right — a heavy riveted gunmetal barrel-torso of bolted scrap plates, a flat anvil-shaped head with a single horizontal ember-orange furnace-slit eye, and a stubby smokestack collar (no smoke drawn). EXACTLY two detached chunky steel mitten-hands (smooth blocks, no fingers) floating clear at each side and two detached blocky stomp-foot plates below, all with clear flat-green gaps; rust-streaked cel shadow bands, charcoal spot-blacks in the seams. Palette: gunmetal #3A4049 plate, charcoal #22252B joints, steel #5A6472 rivets, rust #A8482E weathering, lone ember-orange #FF8A2B furnace glow.
characters.flavor: Built to guard one gate forever; the gate is long gone, so now it guards you.

characters.name: Cinderpyre
characters.theme: A living ember-spirit bound in a cracked stone shell — a flame avatar that walks slow and burns from within, never spilling its fire.
characters.palette: Charcoal #22252B cracked-stone shell with gunmetal #3A4049 plates, ember-orange #FF8A2B molten core-cracks, tan #C49A5A ash-dusting along the edges.
characters.artBrief: Same Drifter rig and flat-cel look: an elemental avatar in bold side-profile facing right — a hunched charcoal volcanic-rock torso fissured with bright ember-orange molten cracks read as flat solid shapes (no glow, no flame, no sparks), one ember-orange slit eye, and a jagged broken-stone crown for a head. EXACTLY two detached cracked-stone bean hands (no fingers) floating clear at each side and two detached blocky rock feet below, all with flat-green gaps; tan ash-dust on the upper edges, charcoal spot-blacks deep in the fissures. Palette: charcoal #22252B and gunmetal #3A4049 stone shell, ember-orange #FF8A2B molten cracks, tan #C49A5A ash.
characters.flavor: Speaks rarely, and every word leaves a scorch mark on the floor.

characters.name: Hollowmaw
characters.theme: A hooded zealot who traded his face to a thing between the stars — a robed devotee whispering rites no one else can hear.
characters.palette: Charcoal #22252B and gunmetal #3A4049 robes, off-white #E8E4D8 bone-mask, arc-violet #B14BFF eldritch sigil and eye-glow, dull-teal #3C6E6A tarnished trim.
characters.artBrief: Same Drifter rig and flat-cel look: an eldritch cultist in bold side-profile facing right — a tall hunched figure in heavy charcoal layered robes with a deep pointed hood that swallows the head in shadow, a pale off-white segmented bone half-mask with a single arc-violet sigil-eye, and a dull-teal tarnished chest-clasp. EXACTLY two detached pale bean hands (no fingers) emerging from wide sleeves and floating clear at each side, and two detached cloth-wrapped feet below, all with flat-green gaps; deep charcoal spot-blacks inside the hood, flat cel shadow on the robe folds. Palette: charcoal #22252B and gunmetal #3A4049 robes, off-white #E8E4D8 mask, lone arc-violet #B14BFF sigil-glow, dull-teal #3C6E6A trim.
characters.flavor: He is not praying to you, but the thing he prays to is always listening.

characters.name: Thornroot
characters.theme: A wandering bramble-warden grown from old battlefield soil — a slow, rooted plant-folk that drinks the sun and outlasts everything.
characters.palette: Olive #6E7042 bark-body, charcoal #22252B knots and shadow, tan #C49A5A dry-stalk fibres, muted-red #9E3B36 thorn-tips and a single bloom, plasma-lime #9CFF3B new-growth eye.
characters.artBrief: Same Drifter rig and flat-cel look: a plant-folk warden in bold side-profile facing right — a stout olive-green bark-and-vine torso wrapped in tan dry-stalk fibres, a crown of jagged leaves and bramble for a head with a single plasma-lime bud-eye, and short muted-red thorns ridging the spine. EXACTLY two detached gnarled root-knuckle hands (rounded wooden blobs, no fingers) floating clear at each side and two detached splayed root-cluster feet below, all with flat-green gaps; charcoal spot-black knots, a lone muted-red bloom on the shoulder, flat cel shadow bands on the bark. Palette: olive #6E7042 bark, charcoal #22252B knots, tan #C49A5A fibres, muted-red #9E3B36 thorns and bloom, plasma-lime #9CFF3B eye.
characters.flavor: Patient as a season, and every wound it takes just sprouts something meaner.
